verdict.rationale: The embedded agent-builder mode says Stripe manages "the full checkout lifecycle … including … fulfillment" and sends the agent a `delegated_checkout.requested_session.completed` webhook. Checkout sessions also carry documented statuses through completed or canceled. That gives the agent only a thin, push-based completion signal, not a documented way to query order status after purchase. Link CLI transaction history is financial data, not order tracking. Missing for 10: an agent-side API or tool to query post-purchase order status, shipment or tracking information, fulfillment status updates to the agent, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
